blind.thesis: Breakout out of a long coil in a trending, calm-volatility cell with maximum confidence and strong conviction. Wide trailing target suits the structure; only flaw is modest volume on the break.
Breakdown short at ADX 13, the weakest trend reading in the set, after a slow slide that already gave back most of the range. Trailing leg needs follow-through that chop rarely provides.
Pullback confidence under 0.1 and conviction ~0.22 despite ADX 37: price crashed through and now idles at the midline with no sign of resumption. Volatility percentile is high. Poor evidence.
Short after a retreat from highs in a trending cell, midline still above; confidence only 0.43 and six same-direction crypto positions are already open. Target of about 2.7R is reasonable.
Pullback after a strong volume-backed recovery, ADX 36 and price lower in range, but the last bars faded and confidence is only middling. Stop at 2.5 ATR with a 4R target is balanced.
ADX above 60 and price about 3.6 ATR above the midline mean this is an extended move, not a pullback. Bracket stop is a quarter ATR, a fraction of the signal's own risk, and is stopped out by noise.
Chop at ADX 17, volatile conditions, ten same-direction crypto positions and conviction under 0.5. The stop is recorded above entry for a long, so risk placement cannot be assessed.
Breakdown after a heavy-volume reversal off highs with high confidence and conviction, but volatility is at an extreme percentile and the 3-ATR drop is already in. Mixed existing exposure.
Middling confidence, stale eight-bar sweep and a small gap in a volatile transitional cell; stop is recorded above entry for a long. Six same-direction crypto positions already open.
Quiet range, then a washout bar on 2.4x volume that sweeps lows, followed by a displacement back up and a decent gap. Textbook shape; the 3.5-ATR stop for 1.5R is the flaw.
Short on a sweep of the highs with a full-body displacement, but it fades a strong ADX-29 uptrend that has not yet broken structure. Gap is small and a 3.3-ATR stop is on the wide side.
